assumptions: Criteria remain pending the lead gate and independent review, despite all targeted rows passing.

Production authority transport is VELDO-0323, not built on this branch. As the existing wrapper does, the helper reports ledger_unreachable with an enabled installation and no wiring. It opens no private ledger and sends nothing. Rows inject the receiver-style authority wiring; a live central-service gate is not proven.

The fixtures alone supply the two unbuilt act checks (VELDO-0332 and VELDO-0339), an empty process table, synthetic free-byte readings and a stub Docker client. Production act guards, signatures, packet checks, probes, keeper and removers are unchanged. No actual engine, protected volume or owner data was touched.

Admission retries and historical needs are later tickets; this helper uses the current arithmetic. The unconfirmed no-space retry policy is not built: an error without a below-floor pool keeps the ordinary verdict.

The shell rows retain gate ordering and stamp code, replacing catalogs and confinement helpers only in throwaway fixtures. Kills are real SIGKILL at the checks and stamp boundary. The standard full gate, heavy suites, policy checker and suite 86 captures were not run or edited.

Development found two fixture setup mistakes and an absent-stamp assertion that raised instead of producing its named red row. These were corrected. Final records are from the complete rerun after the inactive-log correction; no failed run is counted as evidence of detection.
The docs check exited 0 and reported pass while printing paths of older non-ASCII artifacts. Changed files were separately checked as ASCII.
rollback: Revert the gate steps, helper, scaffold entry and the two protected helper entries. Gate behavior returns to the previous form.
